screened_out.reason: Korean 대리 수치/대리 수치심 already provides a compact conventional equivalent for vicarious embarrassment, so expression cost is too low for priority admission.
Korean 만감이 교차하다 is a compact conventional idiom preserving the central sense of many emotions converging at once.
Korean 덧없다 already compresses much of the transience/ephemerality sense; preserve for comparison rather than priority admission.
